past_incidents.title: salescreate-api incident: bad-release (35.0% errors)
past_incidents.root_cause: Active task definition salescreate-api:15 on salescreate-api introduced configuration/release drift (RELEASE_VERSION: 'v2.4.0' -> 'v2.4.1-bad') compared to healthy baseline salescreate-api:14, triggering KeyError: KeyError: 'discount_tier' in checkout_pricing.calculate_tier_discount (introduced in v2.4.1-bad).
past_incidents.resolution: Roll back salescreate-api task definition from salescreate-api:15 to healthy baseline salescreate-api:14

past_incidents.title: Notifier SMTP Relay Auth Failure After Secrets Manager Rotation
past_incidents.error_signature: SecretAuthError: SMTP relay rejected credentials for SMTP_SECRET_ID=sec_2026_09_revoked
past_incidents.root_cause: AWS Secrets Manager automatically rotated the SMTP relay credential to sec_2026_10_active, but the notifier ECS task definition remained pinned to revoked secret ID sec_2026_09_revoked.
past_incidents.resolution: Updated SMTP_SECRET_ID=sec_2026_10_active via update_service_env on notifier and forced a new deployment.

past_incidents.title: SalesCreate API Checkout Pricing KeyError Regression in Canary Release
past_incidents.root_cause: Canary deployment v2.4.1-bad accessed payload['customer']['discount_tier'] directly without a default fallback, causing HTTP 500 errors on ~35% of guest/standard checkout orders.
past_incidents.resolution: Rolled back salescreate-api task definition from revision salescreate-api:15 (v2.4.1-bad) to healthy baseline revision salescreate-api:14 (v2.4.0).

past_incidents.title: Inventory Worker Row Lock Contention on Hot SKU-9901
past_incidents.error_signature: DeadlockDetectedError: Pessimistic lock wait timeout (30ms) exceeded on table inventory_ledger for hot SKU-9901
past_incidents.root_cause: Task definition override lowered LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS to 30ms (vs 1500ms baseline), causing 60% of concurrent stock reservations on hot SKU-9901 to abort with DeadlockDetectedError.
past_incidents.resolution: Restored LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS=1500 via update_service_env on inventory-worker.
